- In `OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java`, the introduction of the `isSavedFaG` variable allows for a clearer check on whether the filtering and grouping data is saved, and it ensures that this data is only discarded after the global optimization is complete.

Together, these changes ensure that the `savedFilteringAndGrouping` is preserved during the asynchronous operation and is only cleared when it is no longer needed, thus fixing the bug related to its premature disposal.
